_comment: Approved third-party plugins. A change needs a pull request citing docs/plugins/third-party.md and a rerun of the visibility matrix. Versions must equal composer.lock. Forbidden kinds (SEO, public login, payment, AI drafting, page builders) fail even if listed.

plugins.reason: Background jobs, used as a library inside whoiswho-core (docs/plugins/third-party.md: Background jobs, Chosen). Touches no personal data of its own.

Per-user capability and role screen (docs/plugins/third-party.md: Per-user capability screen, Decided Q86; owner approved on issue #2). Limited to wiw_manage_capabilities (Administrator only), loaded by whoiswho-core; the guard still refuses fixed capabilities. Touches no visitor data.
